errors.evidence: The description states there are five banks, but the chart legend and data show six banks. The description completely omits 'Д Банк' (D Bank).
The description omits the data series for 'Д Банк' (D Bank), which is represented by the light blue line on the chart.
The description claims the lines have round markers, but the lines in the chart are solid and do not have any markers.

errors.text_span: се увеличава до около 12% през 2011 г.
errors.evidence: For 'Интернешънъл Асет Банк', the description incorrectly states that its value increases to about 12% in 2011. In fact, the line peaks at around 12.5-13% in 2009 and drops to around 9% by 2011.
The line for 'Инвест банк' is described as brown ('кафява'), but it is clearly orange in the chart.
The description for 'ЦКБ' states it starts at about 15% in 2008, but the chart shows the starting value is clearly lower, at approximately 14%.
The description for 'Интернешънъл Асет Банк' states it starts at about 8% in 2008, but the chart shows the starting value is higher, at approximately 9%.
The description for 'Общинска банка' uses the awkward and repetitive phrase 'grey-grey-grey line' ('сиво-сиво-сиво линия') instead of simply 'grey line' ('сива линия').
